templates.name: Add Production Pattern
templates.description: Add a new production log pattern with tests
templates.instructions: Add pattern ${pattern_name} with regex ${regex}, sample logs, and unit tests. Validate 350+ THG performance.

templates.name: Fix Failing Test
templates.description: Debug and fix a failing test
templates.instructions: Debug test failure in ${test_file}. Check Vector binary, temp directories, and pattern syntax. Run with verbose output.

templates.name: Optimize VRL Performance
templates.description: Optimize VRL code for better THG rating
templates.instructions: Optimize ${pattern} for 350+ THG. Replace regex with built-ins, use split/contains, minimize parsing.

templates.name: Build and Test
templates.description: Run complete build and test cycle
templates.instructions: Run 3-stage build, execute all tests, update TODO.md with results.

templates.name: Update Documentation
templates.instructions: Update documentation for ${change_description}. Update version, add to changelog, update TODO.

templates.name: Sync Dependencies
templates.instructions: Sync Vector dependencies to vector-bindings. Run dependency_sync.py and rebuild.

templates.name: Performance Report
templates.description: Generate performance report for all patterns
templates.instructions: Test all patterns, measure THG scores, generate performance report, update TODO.

templates.name: Vector Version Update
templates.instructions: Test with Vector ${version}. Run build, test compatibility, document issues.

templates.name: Create Test Fixture
templates.description: Create new test fixture for pattern
templates.instructions: Create fixture for ${pattern} with sample logs and expected output. Include THG target.

templates.name: Debug Import Error
templates.instructions: Fix import error in ${error_file}. Check PYTHONPATH, __init__.py files, and module structure.

pattern_name.description: Name of the log pattern (e.g., apache_combined, nginx_access)

test_file.description: Path to the failing test file
